help.topic.newRequestsBody: How new work reaches you on Home.
help.topic.newRequestsTips: Stay Online on Home to get new work when allowed.|Use Receive Requests if you want open requests while Offline (when Admin allows it).|New requests appear on Home — accept or decline there.|Turn on notifications so you don't miss a request.
help.topic.onlineReceiveBody: Two different controls on Home — not the same as My Services.
help.topic.onlineReceiveTips: Online / Offline is your overall status for the day.|Receive Requests is whether you want new open requests.|My Services ON/OFF is per service — pausing Plumbing does not make you Offline overall.|Manage Online and Receive Requests from Home.
help.topic.serviceOnOffBody: Accept new jobs for one service only.
help.topic.serviceOnOffTips: Open Settings → My Services.|Tap Pause to stop new jobs for that service.|Your Home Online status does not change.|Existing accepted jobs continue as usual.
help.topic.myServicesBody: Services you offer and their details.
help.topic.myServicesTips: Open Settings → My Services to see each service.|Tap a service row to open details, documents, and review status.|Add a service if you offer more than one skill.
help.topic.documentsBody: Upload papers and submit a service for review.
help.topic.documentsTips: Open the service under My Services.|Upload required documents, then Submit for review.|Status shows Needs documents, Under review, Approved, or Needs changes.|We'll update status after review.
help.topic.jobWorkflowBody: Accept, start, and finish customer work.
help.topic.jobWorkflowTips: Active jobs are under Active.|Open a job for address, requirements, and next action.|Follow Start work → In progress → Complete.|Use Messages on the job when you need to talk about the work.
help.topic.customerContactBody: How to reach the customer for a job.
help.topic.customerContactTips: Open the job details for Call when a number is available.|Use job messages for written updates.|Do not share private numbers outside Akansho when the app hides them.|For app issues, contact Akansho support below.
help.topic.loginOtpBody: Not receiving OTP or facing login issues?
help.topic.loginOtpTips: Check the mobile number is correct (10 digits).|Wait 45 seconds, then tap Resend OTP.|OTP expires after a short time — request a new one.|Make sure SMS is not blocked on your phone.
help.topic.pinBody: Facing issue while creating or resetting PIN?
help.topic.pinTips: PIN must be 4 digits.|Avoid easy PINs like 1234 or 0000.|Use Forgot PIN on the login screen to reset with OTP.|To change PIN after login: Settings → Account → Sign out to change PIN.
help.topic.accountBody: Update profile, documents or account related issues.
help.topic.accountTips: Open Settings → Profile after login to update name and photo.|Services and documents are under Settings → My Services.|Language and appearance are under Account & security.|Verification may take time after you upload documents.
help.topic.feedbackBody: Share your feedback to help us improve.
help.topic.feedbackTips: Tell us what is confusing or what would help you get more jobs.
help.topic.otherBody: Can't find your issue? We're here to help.
help.topic.otherTips: Describe what you were trying to do and what went wrong.|Include your mobile number if you contact us on WhatsApp.
